Container.Name: Quake
Container.Overview:
id Software's 1999 Quake source release, repaired to build and run on a current 64-bit Linux and packaged so you play it in a browser. Picture and sound both arrive over one port; the mouse is captured, and a game controller works on a phone as well as a desktop.
You supply the game data. Quake's is not free to redistribute -- id's shareware licence covers passing the shareware release along whole, in its original archive, not a pak file lifted out of it -- so point the Game data path below at your own Quake install, the directory holding id1/pak0.pak. Without it the container stops and says so.
Music is optional and separate: Quake's soundtrack was audio tracks on the CD, so put a rip in a music/ folder beside id1 as track02.ogg and friends.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: noVNC and the sound, on one port. Open http://[IP]:[PORT]/play.html

Config.Name: Game data
Config.Description: Your Quake install: the directory holding id1/pak0.pak. Mission packs (hipnotic, rogue), mods and a music/ folder go beside id1. Mounted read-only; nothing is ever written here.

Config.Name: Width
Config.Description: Starting render width, 320 to 1920. The renderer is in software, so every pixel costs; the browser scales whatever it is given to fit the window. Options - Video Options in the game changes the resolution while it runs and remembers the choice, so after the first run this is only the starting point.

Config.Name: Game
Config.Description: Leave empty for the base game. hipnotic for Scourge of Armagon, rogue for Dissolution of Eternity, or a mod directory name. The directory has to be in the game data mount.

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Optional. There is no authentication without it, and the transport is plain HTTP either way -- do not expose this to the internet.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container runs as. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: Restart on exit
Config.Description: 1 brings the title screen back when the game exits or crashes; 0 stops the container instead.

Config.Name: VNC port
Config.Description: Optional. Raw VNC for a native client: picture only, no sound, and the pointer is not captured.
